name: Kettlebell Suitcase Carry
description: Holding one kettlebell at your side like a suitcase, walk tall without leaning, then change hands.

source.title: Farmer's Carry (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: The one-handed (suitcase) version, described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand tall with the bell in one hand at your side.
A clear stretch of floor to walk on.

prescription.note: Stand tall; don't lean towards the bell. Put it down and change hands.

keyframes.name: Right foot forward
keyframes.cue: Walk tall: step with your right foot, weights by your sides.

keyframes.name: Left foot forward
keyframes.cue: Now the left foot; short, steady steps.
